cases.scenario: Standalone steady vessel with physical fluid boundaries and a load/temperature step
cases.notes: EnthalpyBoundary leaves flow and pressure unconstrained; it does not impose DUT conservation laws. A UA absorber solves its steam intake from the prescribed pressure, solution feed and cooling-water conditions. Auxiliary flow ports are sealed by zero-flow sources. Both inputs T_c and Hb_flow_in are supplied for the low generator, allowing throughput to be solved.
